hero.lead: Software engineer with 6+ years shipping distributed systems, cloud platforms and AI products — from police-intelligence integrations moving 2M+ messages a day to a RAG redesign that cut AI costs by 90%.

stats.kafka: Kafka messages a day, public-security platform
stats.ai-cost: AI infrastructure cost after a RAG redesign

availability: Open to senior engineering roles — remote, hybrid or on-site.

intro.title: Engineer, architect, builder.
paragraphs: I design, build and scale software systems — backend and frontend, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and, more and more, AI. I've worked on police-intelligence platforms, subscription billing for the largest telecom in Argentina, multi-tenant HR software, CMS platforms, augmented reality and environmental monitoring.
I hold a degree in Computer Science and an MBA in Software Engineering from USP, and I'm currently doing a postgraduate degree in Applied AI Engineering focused on AI agents and intelligent systems.

I'm most at home where architecture decisions and scaling problems need pragmatic answers. I've lived in several countries, which made me adaptable, a clear communicator and comfortable in remote, multicultural teams.

journey.title: Beyond the code
journey.intro: I grew up in Bahia, Brazil, studied English in Ireland, lived in Argentina and have been working remotely as a digital nomad since 2023 — across Latin America, Europe and Asia. Living in other languages taught me to adapt quickly and to communicate clearly with teams I rarely meet in person.
journey.outro: Outside of work: an adventurous traveller, a lover of online games and sports, and a slow-but-steady student of Mandarin and Japanese.
